description:

💔 Virat Kohli Ki Fighting Hui Bekaar 🔥 Rohit Fir Flop 
India aur England ke beech doosre ODI mein England ne romanchak muqable mein jeet hasil karke series ko 1-1 se barabar kar diya. Virat Kohli ne 65 runs ki fighting innings khelkar Indian innings ko sambhala, jabki Shreyas Iyer ne 66 runs bana kar unka shandaar saath diya. Iske baad bhi England ke Joe Root deewar ki tarah crease par tik gaye aur 99* ki match-winning innings khelkar apni team ko jeet dila di. Sirf 1 run se unka century chook gaya.

Rohit Sharma ek baar phir balle se bada score banane mein nakaam rahe. Match ko dekhte hue Sanju Samson aur Vaibhaw Suryavanshi bhi nazar aaye.

Stadium ke crowd mein Sonam Wangchuk ke support mein banners bhi dekhne ko mile. Sonam Wangchuk Delhi ke Jantar Mantar par NEET paper leak ke protest ke dauran bhookh hartal par baithe hain aur Gen Z ka unhe kaafi support mil raha hai.

Aapke hisaab se match ka turning point kya tha? Virat ki innings, Joe Root ka patience ya kuch aur? Comments mein zaroor batayein.
